title: UTF-8 编码验证
summary: 判断整数数组的低八位是否构成合法 UTF-8 字节序列。
insight: 首字节的连续前导一决定总字节数，后续指定数量的字节必须以二进制 10 开头。
pitfalls: 多字节字符长度只能为二到四
序列末尾不能缺少延续字节

solutions.title: 前导位状态扫描
solutions.idea: remaining 记录当前字符仍需要的 10xxxxxx 延续字节数。
steps: remaining=0 时按首字节统计前导一
长度为一或大于四返回假，设置 remaining=count-1
remaining>0 时检查最高两位为 10 并递减，最终需为零

code.java: class Solution { public boolean validUtf8(int[] data){int remaining=0;for(int value:data){value&=255;if(remaining==0){if((value&128)==0)continue;int count=0,mask=128;while((value&mask)!=0){count++;mask>>=1;}if(count==1||count>4)return false;remaining=count-1;}else{if((value&192)!=128)return false;remaining--;}}return remaining==0;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun validUtf8(data:IntArray):Boolean{var remaining=0;for(raw in data){val value=raw and 255;if(remaining==0){if(value and 128==0)continue;var count=0;var mask=128;while(value and mask!=0){count++;mask=mask shr 1};if(count==1||count>4)return false;remaining=count-1}else{if(value and 192!=128)return false;remaining--}};return remaining==0} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool validUtf8(vector<int>& data){int remaining=0;for(int raw:data){int value=raw&255;if(remaining==0){if((value&128)==0)continue;int count=0,mask=128;while(value&mask){++count;mask>>=1;}if(count==1||count>4)return false;remaining=count-1;}else{if((value&192)!=128)return false;--remaining;}}return remaining==0;} };
